library.description: Store snapshot persistence and storage adapter protocol.

blocks.text: 把 Store、集合或单个键的快照接到存储后端，协调启动恢复、本地修改和有序写回。

items: 存档恢复完成后用户刚改的字段又变回旧值，因为读取结果直接覆盖了启动后的内存状态。
坏存档还没查清就被默认值覆盖，因为“读取结束”被误当成“恢复成功”。
升级后旧字段没有转换，临时字段却进入了存档，因为 schema 迁移和写入裁剪没有分开。
购物车的 Map 保存后变成空对象，因为普通 JSON 不保留集合条目。
离开一个用户页面却影响其他用户的保存，因为整个定义族共用持久化生命周期。
恢复旧字段，同时保留启动后的本地修改。 不直接用晚到存档覆盖整个对象，例子保留本地计数并恢复未改主题，再保存两者，见同名场景。
恢复失败时先关闭写入，修复成功后再继续。 不让默认状态提前覆盖坏存档，例子检查原档不变、相同错误对象和重试后的保存，见同名场景。
版本转换与保存字段分别声明。 不把旧结构当成新结构，也不每次保存全部会话状态，例子迁移主题并排除临时字段，见同名场景。
集合条目由默认 codec 往返保存。 不让普通 JSON 把 Map 静默变空，例子在新集合恢复书籍数量并移除过时键，见同名场景。
每个键的保存会话独立释放。 不用一个族级开关耦合所有用户，例子停止一个键后另一个仍保存，且内存值继续可用，见同名场景。

blocks.text: 在 ESM 项目保存为 overview.ts，用 Node 24 运行；示例使用真实内存后端，内容只在该后端实例存活期间保留：

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/store-persist @migaia/store-light @migaia/storage-web

import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'
import { memoryStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-web/memory'
import { persist } from '@migaia/store-persist/light'

const storage = memoryStorageHost()
const settings = createStore({ theme: 'light' })
const handle = persist(settings, { key: 'settings', storage })
await handle.ready
settings.theme = 'dark'
await handle.flush()
console.log('已保存：', (await storage.get('settings')) !== null)
handle.dispose()
await settings.$dispose()
storage.dispose()

blocks.text: 本包把状态变化接到存储读写：加载存档、协调水合期间的本地修改、排队写入、管理防抖与释放。它不提供具体存储后端、加密或页面卸载时的可靠保存保证。只需一次性读写而不需要状态同步时，直接使用 storage-contract 和所需后端即可。敏感数据应由应用选择合适的存储与加密 codec，不要把默认 JSON 编码当作加密。

rows: persistUnit 核心、handle / options / envelope 类型、codec 工具、状态与错误。根入口不导出三个 Store 适配函数。

blocks.text: reactive、storage-contract、utils、lifecycle 是运行时依赖。store-light、store-indexed、store-keyed 是可选 peer，只安装所用模型；storage-web 仅在使用其后端或 codec 时安装。代码直接导入的包应直接安装，不能依赖传递依赖恰好可见。memoryStorageHost、localStorageHost、indexedDbHost 从 storage-web 的精确后端子入口取得；本包不在运行时依赖具体 storage-web 值。

persistUnit(unit, options) 是三个适配器共用的引擎。unit 必须提供同步 snapshot()、同步 restore(state) 和 subscribe(onChange)，后者返回退订函数。核心 options 必填 key、runtime、storage；三个 facade 自动使用 Store / collection / AtomStore 自己的 Runtime。状态单位、Runtime 和 storage 均为借用资源。

blocks.text: facade 先捕获 options 自身属性；getter 使用原 options 作为 receiver 读取一次。核心也在创建时捕获配置字段，恢复使用已捕获并验证的 merge，不重新读取调用方的 getter。非对象、反射或 getter 失败以 INVALID_OPTION TypeError 报告，捕获的原因为 cause。key、namespace、id 在拼接前检查字符串，不把对象或数字悄悄转成键，也不额外要求非空字符串。容量时间、version 与回调形状在创建持久化状态前按实际配置校验。
migrate、partialize、merge 都是同步回调，不能返回 Promise / thenable；异步结果或读取 then 失败以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝，避免 Promise 被当作业务状态写入。普通同步业务回调或后端异常保留原来的公共错误路径；不要把所有失败都改判为某一个本包码。

rows: $runtime、$plain、$subscribe、$hydrate 的结构类型，createStore 返回值满足。
snapshot 用 $plain，restore 用 $hydrate，subscribe 显式 fireImmediately: false。
runtime、snapshot()、replace(state)，支持 ObservableObject / Array / Map / Set。
runtime.effect 读取 tracked snapshot，跳过 Effect 构造时的首次同步执行，之后变化触发写入。
peek 取快照，set 恢复，sub 订阅；每次调用建立一个独立单位。

blocks.text: light 的 $plain 只包含 signal 支撑字段，不含 computed、WASM 字段或方法。$hydrate 是宽松写回：只更新已知 signal 字段，未知字段默认跳过。因此 partialize 只保存部分字段时，不会要求恢复未保存字段；本适配器不另设 merge。核心普通对象合并仍负责水合期间的同字段本地修改。
indexed 的 snapshot 保持各集合自身形状，replace 遵循集合整体替换的原子准入；坏存档、版本不匹配等水合前置失败不会调用 restore，不能把“没有进入恢复”夸大为任意外部副作用可回滚。数组 / Map / Set 的部分持久化需要应用提供匹配的 merge，否则缺省整替换可能丢掉未存部分。普通对象的浅字段规则也不代替深层业务合并。

keyed 必填 namespace、storage，其他共同选项按其公开类型提供；实际存储键是 namespace + ':' + id。它没有枚举整个 family 的能力，每个 handle 只管理这一个定义与键。handle.value 是水合前首次获取的值快照，不是实时 AtomStore 值；实时值从 AtomStore 读取。扩展保留原引擎的 live disposed getter，dispose 后立即反映终态。

clearFamily(storage, namespace) 的两个参数均必填，返回 `Promise<number>`。它枚举 storage.keys()，按 namespace + ':' 前缀筛选后逐个 await remove；返回枚举时匹配的数量，不是 remove 返回 true 的独占计数。它不清 AtomStore 内存、不停止现有 handle；活跃值下次变化可再次写入。登出若要同时清业务值，应用还须操作 AtomStore，并按需先停止相关持久化，避免把删除当成永久禁写。

sections.heading: 加载、版本迁移与本地修改

blocks.text: 构造时先捕获启动快照并建立变化订阅，再异步读取存档。存档不存在时水合成功，保留内存初值。存档存在时先解码、验证 envelope，再在 version 不同且提供 migrate 时迁移，最后合并并同步 restore。版本相同不调用 migrate；版本不同而未提供 migrate 以 ENVELOPE_INVALID 拒绝，不把旧值冒充新 schema。

缺省 merge 对普通对象（Object.prototype 或 null 原型）按字段浅比较：以构造时启动快照为基线，用 Object.is 比较当前字段；本地已改字段保留当前值，未改字段接受存档值，同时保留未归档的当前字段。它不是深度冲突解决，嵌套引用内部变化不自动得到逐层比较；重试也沿用这一启动基线。非普通对象、数组、Map、Set 等整体接受持久化形状，自定义 merge 则负责应用自己的规则。
水合期间通知只标 dirty，不提前覆盖未知存档；恢复时的同步通知也归入这个窗口。水合成功后有 dirty 才重新安排写入。水合失败保留错误和 dirty 状态，flush / clear 不写而抛原水合错误；修复配置或存档后，成功 retryHydrate 才重新打开写入。恢复期间再次调用不会另起并行重读，但不保证它等待当前恢复或返回相同 Promise；需要恢复结果时等待发起重试的那次调用。

rows: loading / ready / error / disposed；disposed 优先，水合 loading 次之，水合或写入失败为 error。写入中由独立 writeStatus 表示。
hydrationError 或 writeError；两者都有时生成 HYDRATE_AND_WRITE_FAILED AggregateError，errors 按水合、写入顺序保留。

首次尝试无论成功失败都 resolve 的等待屏障，不表示以后 retry 已完成。
无参数；失败后重读，成功恢复写入；应等待此调用本身判断恢复结果。
无参数，返回 `Promise<void>`，具体串行与删除规则见后文。
live 布尔 getter / 同步幂等释放。
同步停止后等待已接纳的写入/删除及最终防抖写入结束；最终写入失败见 writeError；已有 flush/clear 保留原结果。

blocks.text: status、error、hydrated 是 Runtime computed；hydration / write 的细分状态通过 IReadonlyPersistValue.value 暴露。公开 PersistState 只有 idle、loading、writing、ready、success、error、disposed；没有 active。IPersistCodecOutput 已移除，类型使用 storage-contract 的 ICodecOutput；运行时 PersistCodecOutput 仍保留 text / structured / binary。旧类型与成员导入需迁移，没有兼容 alias。
写入先读最新 unit.snapshot，再同步 partialize，构造 { version, state } 后交给 codec。所有写入和删除沿一条串行链，防止慢的旧写入在新写入后覆盖它。变化会合并为写入请求，但每次实际编码使用排到执行时的快照，不承诺每个中间值都形成一份存档。
debounceMs 大于 0 时等待安静间隔；maxWaitMs 从成功水合后第一个待写变化起固定窗口上限，后续变化只延长安静间隔。maxWaitMs 为 0 是下一次 0ms 调度请求入队；debounceMs 为 0 则直接请求写入，不使用这一防抖窗口。maxWait 只限制请求入队时间，不限制排队等待或后端完成时间。
flush 取消当前防抖窗口，等待首次水合屏障；若水合失败抛原错，否则等待它已经观察到的实际写入，再请求当前快照写入并等待。并发严格 flush 与后台写共享真实 drain 结果，全部等待者能看到同一次原始失败；仅供后续调度恢复的 catch 链不会把这次失败改成成功。各 async 方法的公开 Promise 不被声明为相同 identity。
clear 同样取消窗口并等待水合，然后在写队列后删除此键，不重置业务内存。之后状态变化仍可重新写回。clearFamily 只处理匹配的存储键，不与所有活跃 keyed handle 合成原子事务。浏览器 beforeunload 也不保证等待 flush；应在明确的应用保存边界 await flush，并理解后端完成语义，而非只在卸载事件里 fire-and-forget。
dispose 同步、幂等：标记终态、请求 abort 所有在途适配器操作、取消防抖窗口、停止订阅。它不 dispose 借用的 Store、collection、AtomStore、Runtime 或 storage。释放后 flush / clear / retryHydrate 拒绝为带 ABORTED_BY_DISPOSE 的原生 AbortError，不复用旧 handle。
如果释放截断了一个已排定但未触发的防抖 timer，会当场捕获最后快照，并在既有写链之后发起一次最终写入。该写入不等待、不传已中止的 signal；最终编码 / I/O 或捕获失败保留在 writeError，即使 status 已 disposed。没有 pending timer 时不能笼统声称 dispose 总会额外保存一次。

取消复用 lifecycle 的原生 AbortController 工厂与默认 AbortError reason。后端若忽略 signal，已经发出的操作仍可能完成；等待者会在实际操作结算后观察终态，晚到原始失败保留在 AbortError cause。dispose 不是硬期限或强制终止后端的机制。需要确定保存结果时在资源仍可用时 await flush，再按应用顺序释放 handle 和业务资源。

sections.heading: 存档、默认 codec 与兼容读取

blocks.text: 信封格式为 version（非负安全整数）与 state（非 null / undefined）。assertEnvelope(value, key) 拒绝非对象、数组、非法 version 或缺失 state，返回捕获的 version / state；两属性各读一次，属性访问或反射失败由 PersistEnvelopeError 包装并在 cause 保留。PersistEnvelopeError 继承 TypeError、携带 ENVELOPE_INVALID，key 用于标明存档身份。

defaultJsonCodec 名称为 migaia-collections-json-v1，output 为 text；委托 storage-contract 的 collectionsJsonCodec，支持真实 Map / Set（含跨 realm）往返，避免普通 JSON 将集合静默编码为空对象。它仍继承 JSON 的循环引用、BigInt 等限制，不是任意对象图的无损编码。新格式用版本化元组，其精确保留形状不是可任意占用的普通业务数组。

读取旧存档时，仅唯一自有键为 `__migaia_persist_map__` 或 `__migaia_persist_set__` 且值为数组的对象是旧保留 marker；多字段同名 lookalike 保持全部数据。发现精确旧 marker 后沿 legacy reviver 读取，不把其中原本的普通应用数组重新解释为新元组；没有精确旧 marker 才委托新格式解码。新写入格式与 codec name 不变，不使用相似字段猜集合。
defaultJsonCodec.encode 失败抛 ENCODE_FAILED TypeError，原因为 cause；decode 非字符串或坏 JSON / marker 抛 ENVELOPE_INVALID TypeError，解析失败的原因为 cause。默认 codec 不做加密或脱敏；自定义 codec 必须处理自己声明的数据形状。

sections.heading: 存储投影与 codec 选路

blocks.text: IPersistStorage 是内部最小类型投影，不作为包入口具名导出：capabilities、get、set、remove、keys 来自 IKeyValueStore；不要求 backend、has、clearValues、clearAll 或 dispose。可选 getBytes / setBytes / removeBytes 来自 IRecordStore，不是 IKeyValueStore 本身。binary codec 的 clear() 用 removeBytes 只删除这个 byte key，不清空其他 byte key 或 text/record 通道；声明 binary 却缺少 removeBytes 时，clear 以 BACKEND_CAPABILITY 的 TypeError 拒绝，不回落到 text 删除。后端和 codec 的错误保留各自公共身份与原因，不保证都改成本包 source。

rows: ctx 必填，可为空对象，signal 可省略；structured output 写入明确 CODEC_OUTPUT_MISMATCH，不走 record 通道。
capabilities.binary 为真时要求两个字节方法，缺失为 BACKEND_CAPABILITY；编码值必须是 Uint8Array，否则 CODEC_OUTPUT_MISMATCH。
编码值必须为 string，交 storage.set；不自动 base64 降级。
binary 且 capabilities.binary 为真时走 getBytes，再 codec.decode；缺方法为 BACKEND_CAPABILITY，binary 能力为假则 CODEC_OUTPUT_MISMATCH。非 binary 走 get + decode。不存在时返回 undefined。
按 codec 选择通道删除单个存档：默认 text 走 storage.remove；binary codec 且后端声明 binary 时走 removeBytes，缺少时抛 BACKEND_CAPABILITY 的 TypeError。不改变内存状态。

key、namespace、version、时间、回调、scheduler 或配置不合法。

blocks.text: 配置 version 非负安全整数等非法项同步 TypeError；信封问题由 PersistEnvelopeError 报告。水合失败后 flush / clear 继续抛 hydrationError，成功 retry 才解锁；写入失败查 writeError，并检查 codec 与后端是否匹配。已释放 handle 不能重用，业务内存和存档删除需分别管理。

公开错误工厂 createStorePersistError / createStorePersistTypeError 接收必填 code、message 和可选 options.cause；createStorePersistAbortError 接收 code、message、可选 cause，返回原生 DOMException，保持 name 为 AbortError；createStorePersistAggregateError 接收 code、errors、message，errors 保留原失败。code 类型为 IStorePersistErrorCode，工厂附加身份但不覆盖 stack。底层工具不需要在普通 Store 使用中自行重复实现。
包已有 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test、build 和 test:packed 脚本；实际报告说明哪些被执行，不以手册列出命令当成验证结论。排查未保存字段先看 partialize 与 debounce，再看 hydrationError / writeError；Map / Set 形状不对时检查是否换用了不支持集合的 codec。
按状态形状选择持久化适配器，分别管理水合、写入结果和资源所有权。最短入口见 README。

sections.id: 恢复存档时保留启动期修改
sections.heading: 恢复存档时保留启动期修改

blocks.text: 设置存档里有旧计数，用户却在启动恢复完成前改了计数。
直接用存档覆盖整个对象会丢掉新计数；完全跳过恢复，又会丢掉用户尚未修改的已存字段。
先接入 `persist`，再允许编辑并等待 `ready`；默认普通对象合并逐字段对照启动快照，保留本地修改，再用 `flush` 保存合并结果。

memoryStorageHost() 提供本例真实内存后端，初始存档 key 为 settings。defaultJsonCodec 编码完整 version: 0 / state 信封；createStore 初值为 light / 0，省略 Runtime 使用默认实例。persist 必填 key 与 storage，未传 version 为 0、debounceMs 为 0、partialize 为恒等；普通对象默认浅三向合并，最后 await flush 确定本次写入结束。
输出：

blocks.code:
恢复： dark 1
保存： dark 1

blocks.text: 依次输出 `恢复： dark 1`、`保存： dark 1`：主题来自存档，计数保留启动后的本地值。
`version` 默认 `0`，`debounceMs` 默认 `0`；普通对象按字段做浅层 `Object.is` 比较，数组、`Map`、`Set` 则整体替换。

sections.id: 修复坏存档后再恢复写入
sections.heading: 修复坏存档后再恢复写入

blocks.text: 启动时读到了损坏存档，恢复失败后用户仍在修改内存中的设置。
这时立即保存默认值，会在排查或修复前覆盖原存档；把等待结束误当成恢复成功，也会造成同样的问题。
捕获 `ready` 的失败并修复真实存储记录，再等待 `retryHydrate` 成功后调用 `flush`；只有成功读取与恢复后才重新开放写入。
storage.set 先写入坏 JSON，本例保留首次 ready 和错误对象。ready 拒绝不会把内存改动写回，retryHydrate 无参数并重新读取已修复存档；之后等待该次重试与 flush。settled 不等于恢复成功，ready 不因 retry 替换。所有 key / codec / 防抖默认与上一例相同。
输出：

blocks.code:
写入暂停： error true
原档未变： true
恢复完成： ready 2 true
首次尝试： true

blocks.text: 依次输出 `写入暂停： error true`、`原档未变： true`、`恢复完成： ready 2 true`、`首次尝试： true`。
恢复失败会暂停自动写入，`flush` 也拒绝并保留同一个失败对象；重试仍使用原启动快照，且不替换 `ready`，`settled` 只等待首次尝试结束。

sections.id: 迁移旧设置并只保存指定字段
sections.heading: 迁移旧设置并只保存指定字段

blocks.text: 新版本重命名了已存字段，同时有些会话数据只应留在内存里。
把旧数据当成新结构读取会漏掉改名字段；每次保存整个对象又会把临时数据写进存档。
显式设置 `version: 2`，用同步 `migrate` 转换旧状态，再用 `partialize` 选择保存字段；本例读取版本 `1`，写入时只保留主题。

目标 version 从默认 0 覆盖为 2，旧 envelope.version 为 1。migrate 接收旧 state 和 fromVersion，必须同步返回新 state；partialize 只返回 theme，覆盖默认完整保存。temporary 未持久化但保留在当前 Store；默认 merge 仍基于启动快照，light 恢复走 $hydrate。字符串转换是本例 schema 规则，不是通用迁移策略。
输出：

blocks.code:
迁移： 1 dark session-only
存档： 2 contrast false

blocks.text: 依次输出 `迁移： 1 dark session-only`、`存档： 2 contrast false`：旧主题完成转换，临时字段没有进入存档。
`version` 默认 `0`，不匹配且未提供 `migrate` 会恢复失败；`partialize` 默认原样保存，两个回调都必须同步返回。`migrate` 转换待恢复状态，本例等待 `flush` 确认新版存档写入。

sections.heading: 完整恢复 Map 条目

blocks.text: 购物车使用可观察的 `Map`，重新创建集合后仍需恢复条目。
直接做普通 JSON 序列化会把 `Map` 变成空对象；只向新集合追加条目，也可能留下已经过时的键。
把真实 `ObservableMap` 交给 `persistCollection`，释放前等待 `flush`；默认编解码器保留 `Map` 条目，恢复时调用集合的 `replace`。
ObservableMap 初始为空，恢复目标初始只有 stale: 99，两者均省略 Runtime 使用各自默认选择。persistCollection 接受集合及 key / storage，不需要额外订阅包装；默认 codec 支持 Map，version 与 debounceMs 都为 0。Map 缺省整替换，所以旧目标中的 stale 会消失；部分保存时需显式匹配的 merge。

blocks.code:
import { ObservableMap } from '@migaia/store-indexed'
import { memoryStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-web/memory'
import { defaultJsonCodec } from '@migaia/store-persist'
import { persistCollection } from '@migaia/store-persist/indexed'

const storage = memoryStorageHost()
const cart = new ObservableMap<string, number>()
const first = persistCollection(cart, { key: 'cart', storage })
await first.ready
cart.set('book', 2)
await first.flush()
first.dispose()
cart.dispose()
const restored = new ObservableMap<string, number>([['stale', 99]])
const second = persistCollection(restored, { key: 'cart', storage })
await second.ready
console.log('恢复：', restored.get('book'), restored.has('stale'))
const saved = (await defaultJsonCodec.decode(await storage.get('cart'))) as { state: unknown }
console.log('映射：', saved.state instanceof Map)
second.dispose()
restored.dispose()
storage.dispose()

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
恢复： 2 false
映射： true

blocks.text: 依次输出 `恢复： 2 false`、`映射： true`：书籍数量恢复，过时键消失，解码后的存档仍包含真正的 `Map`。
`codec` 默认 `defaultJsonCodec`，`version` 和 `debounceMs` 默认 `0`；`Map` 恢复会整体替换，裁剪后需要特殊合并时应显式提供 `merge`。

sections.id: 独立停止某个键的持久化
sections.heading: 独立停止某个键的持久化

blocks.text: 两个用户资料来自同一定义族，离开其中一个页面时只需停止保存该用户。
整族共用一个保存订阅会耦合无关的键；把 `handle.value` 当成实时值读取，还会一直看到恢复前捕获的快照。
为每个定义和显式 `id` 创建独立的 `persistKeyed` 句柄；等待 `ready` 后从 `AtomStore` 读取当前值，只释放不再需要保存的那一个句柄。

createAtomStore 使用本例显式创建的 Runtime；familyDef 初始化各 key 为 name 为空字符串。persistKeyed 的 def、字符串 id、namespace、storage 都明确传入；storage key 为 users:u1 / users:u2，不从定义自动推导。first.value 是初始快照，实时值用 atoms.peek；两个 handle 独立，释放后不会销毁 AtomStore。
输出：

blocks.code:
初始值： true Ada
两个存档： Grace Barbara
内存： Changed

blocks.text: 依次输出 `初始值： true Ada`、`两个存档： Grace Barbara`、`内存： Changed`：停止 `u1` 后它的旧存档保留，`u2` 继续保存。
存储键是 `namespace:id`，`id` 不从定义推导；`value` 是接入时快照。释放持久化不会释放 `AtomStore` 或重置业务值，`version` 和 `debounceMs` 默认 `0`。

sections.id: 清理存档而不重置内存值
sections.heading: 清理存档而不重置内存值

blocks.text: 退出流程清除了某个命名空间的存档，已挂载页面却仍持有当前值。
删除记录不会重置内存或移除订阅；误以为两者一起完成，下一次编辑就会重新创建已经清理的存档。
用 `clearFamily` 移除匹配记录，再分别决定是否重置业务值、释放持久化句柄；本例故意保留句柄，展示后续变更再次写入。
clearFamily 的 storage 与 namespace 两参数必填，users 只匹配 users: 前缀，不匹配 other:u1。返回匹配键数；不会删除内存定义或订阅。本例 active handle 仍存活，atoms.set 后再 await flush 就会重建存档；应用要永久停止保存时需另外 dispose 对应 handle。

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { createAtomStore, familyDef } from '@migaia/store-keyed'
import { memoryStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-web/memory'
import { persistKeyed, clearFamily } from '@migaia/store-persist/keyed'

const storage = memoryStorageHost()
await storage.set('other:u1', 'keep')
const atoms = createAtomStore(createRuntime())
const counter = familyDef(() => 0)
const def = counter('u1')
const handle = persistKeyed(atoms, def, 'u1', { namespace: 'users', storage })
await handle.ready
atoms.set(def, 7)
await handle.flush()
console.log('匹配数：', await clearFamily(storage, 'users'))
console.log(
  '清理后：',
  await storage.get('users:u1'),
  atoms.peek(def),
  await storage.get('other:u1')
)
atoms.set(def, 8)
await handle.flush()
console.log('重新保存：', (await storage.get('users:u1')) !== null)
handle.dispose()
atoms.dispose()
storage.dispose()

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
匹配数： 1
清理后： null 7 keep
重新保存： true

blocks.text: 依次输出 `匹配数： 1`、`清理后： null 7 keep`、`重新保存： true`：只删除 `users:u1`，内存仍是 `7`，后续编辑再次生成存档。
返回值是枚举时以命名空间加冒号匹配的键数，不累计移除操作的布尔结果；移除按顺序执行，不是事务，后续后端调用失败不会撤回已经删除的记录。
本包把状态变化接到存储读写：加载存档、协调水合期间的本地修改、排队写入、管理防抖与释放。它不提供具体存储后端、加密或页面卸载时的可靠保存保证。只需一次性读写而不需要状态同步时，直接使用 storage-contract 和所需后端即可。敏感数据应由应用选择合适的存储与加密 codec，不要把默认 JSON 编码当作加密。

rows: persistUnit 核心、handle / options / envelope 类型、codec 工具、状态与错误。根入口不导出三个 Store 适配函数。

blocks.text: reactive、storage-contract、utils、lifecycle 是运行时依赖。store-light、store-indexed、store-keyed 是可选 peer，只安装所用模型；storage-web 仅在使用其后端或 codec 时安装。代码直接导入的包应直接安装，不能依赖传递依赖恰好可见。memoryStorageHost、localStorageHost、indexedDbHost 从 storage-web 的精确后端子入口取得；本包不在运行时依赖具体 storage-web 值。

persistUnit(unit, options) 是三个适配器共用的引擎。unit 必须提供同步 snapshot()、同步 restore(state) 和 subscribe(onChange)，后者返回退订函数。核心 options 必填 key、runtime、storage；三个 facade 自动使用 Store / collection / AtomStore 自己的 Runtime。状态单位、Runtime 和 storage 均为借用资源。

rows: 必填字符串；决定存档键，字符串不被强制转型。
仅核心显式必填；持有状态信号，facade 自动提供。
必填，满足最小 KeyValueStore 投影；见后文选路。
defaultJsonCodec；编码完整的 version / state 信封，而不只编码 state。
未设置；存档版本不同时执行 migrate(persisted, fromVersion)，缺失则水合失败。keyed facade 不公开此选项。
恒等函数；写入前从当前快照裁出需要保存的字段。
核心 / indexed / keyed 可自定义 merge(persisted, current)；缺省浅三向合并普通对象，其他形状整体替换。light 不公开 merge 选项。
0，不防抖；有限数，范围 0 到 2147483647，允许小数。
未设置；同一数值范围，限制防抖窗口，不是 I/O 期限。
canonical systemScheduler；提供单调 now 与可取消 schedule 任务。

blocks.text: facade 先捕获 options 自身属性；getter 使用原 options 作为 receiver 读取一次。核心也在创建时捕获配置字段，恢复使用已捕获并验证的 merge，不重新读取调用方的 getter。非对象、反射或 getter 失败以 INVALID_OPTION TypeError 报告，捕获的原因为 cause。key、namespace、id 在拼接前检查字符串，不把对象或数字悄悄转成键，也不额外要求非空字符串。容量时间、version 与回调形状在创建持久化状态前按实际配置校验。
migrate、partialize、merge 都是同步回调，不能返回 Promise / thenable；异步结果或读取 then 失败以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝，避免 Promise 被当作业务状态写入。普通同步业务回调或后端异常保留原来的公共错误路径；不要把所有失败都改判为某一个本包码。

rows: $runtime、$plain、$subscribe、$hydrate 的结构类型，createStore 返回值满足。
snapshot 用 $plain，restore 用 $hydrate，subscribe 显式 fireImmediately: false。
runtime、snapshot()、replace(state)，支持 ObservableObject / Array / Map / Set。
runtime.effect 读取 tracked snapshot，跳过 Effect 构造时的首次同步执行，之后变化触发写入。
peek 取快照，set 恢复，sub 订阅；每次调用建立一个独立单位。

blocks.text: light 的 $plain 只包含 signal 支撑字段，不含 computed、WASM 字段或方法。$hydrate 是宽松写回：只更新已知 signal 字段，未知字段默认跳过。因此 partialize 只保存部分字段时，不会要求恢复未保存字段；本适配器不另设 merge。核心普通对象合并仍负责水合期间的同字段本地修改。
indexed 的 snapshot 保持各集合自身形状，replace 遵循集合整体替换的原子准入；坏存档、版本不匹配等水合前置失败不会调用 restore，不能把“没有进入恢复”夸大为任意外部副作用可回滚。数组 / Map / Set 的部分持久化需要应用提供匹配的 merge，否则缺省整替换可能丢掉未存部分。普通对象的浅字段规则也不代替深层业务合并。

keyed 必填 namespace、storage，其他共同选项按其公开类型提供；实际存储键是 namespace + ':' + id。它没有枚举整个 family 的能力，每个 handle 只管理这一个定义与键。handle.value 是水合前首次获取的值快照，不是实时 AtomStore 值；实时值从 AtomStore 读取。扩展保留原引擎的 live disposed getter，dispose 后立即反映终态。

clearFamily(storage, namespace) 的两个参数均必填，返回 `Promise<number>`。它枚举 storage.keys()，按 namespace + ':' 前缀筛选后逐个 await remove；返回枚举时匹配的数量，不是 remove 返回 true 的独占计数。它不清 AtomStore 内存、不停止现有 handle；活跃值下次变化可再次写入。登出若要同时清业务值，应用还须操作 AtomStore，并按需先停止相关持久化，避免把删除当成永久禁写。

sections.id: 加载-版本迁移与本地修改
sections.heading: 加载、版本迁移与本地修改

blocks.text: 构造时先捕获启动快照并建立变化订阅，再异步读取存档。存档不存在时水合成功，保留内存初值。存档存在时先解码、验证 envelope，再在 version 不同且提供 migrate 时迁移，最后合并并同步 restore。版本相同不调用 migrate；版本不同而未提供 migrate 以 ENVELOPE_INVALID 拒绝，不把旧值冒充新 schema。

缺省 merge 对普通对象（Object.prototype 或 null 原型）按字段浅比较：以构造时启动快照为基线，用 Object.is 比较当前字段；本地已改字段保留当前值，未改字段接受存档值，同时保留未归档的当前字段。它不是深度冲突解决，嵌套引用内部变化不自动得到逐层比较；重试也沿用这一启动基线。非普通对象、数组、Map、Set 等整体接受持久化形状，自定义 merge 则负责应用自己的规则。
水合期间通知只标 dirty，不提前覆盖未知存档；恢复时的同步通知也归入这个窗口。水合成功后有 dirty 才重新安排写入。水合失败保留错误和 dirty 状态，flush / clear 不写而抛原水合错误；修复配置或存档后，成功 retryHydrate 才重新打开写入。恢复期间再次调用不会另起并行重读，但不保证它等待当前恢复或返回相同 Promise；需要恢复结果时等待发起重试的那次调用。

rows: loading / ready / error / disposed；disposed 优先，水合 loading 次之，水合或写入失败为 error。写入中由独立 writeStatus 表示。
hydrationError 或 writeError；两者都有时生成 HYDRATE_AND_WRITE_FAILED AggregateError，errors 按水合、写入顺序保留。
hydrationStatus 是否为 success，不等同于 handle 尚未释放。
loading / success / error，重试时重新经历该状态。
当前水合错误，成功后清除。
最近写入错误；正常成功写入清除，释放后的最终写入失败也可保留在这里。
首次 hydrate 尝试的 Promise：成功 resolve，失败或完成前被释放中断则 reject；重试不替换原 Promise。
首次尝试无论成功失败都 resolve 的等待屏障，不表示以后 retry 已完成。
无参数；失败后重读，成功恢复写入；应等待此调用本身判断恢复结果。
无参数，返回 `Promise<void>`，具体串行与删除规则见后文。
live 布尔 getter / 同步幂等释放。
同步停止后等待已接纳的写入/删除及最终防抖写入结束；最终写入失败见 writeError；已有 flush/clear 保留原结果。

blocks.text: status、error、hydrated 是 Runtime computed；hydration / write 的细分状态通过 IReadonlyPersistValue.value 暴露。公开 PersistState 只有 idle、loading、writing、ready、success、error、disposed；没有 active。IPersistCodecOutput 已移除，类型使用 storage-contract 的 ICodecOutput；运行时 PersistCodecOutput 仍保留 text / structured / binary。旧类型与成员导入需迁移，没有兼容 alias。
写入先读最新 unit.snapshot，再同步 partialize，构造 { version, state } 后交给 codec。所有写入和删除沿一条串行链，防止慢的旧写入在新写入后覆盖它。变化会合并为写入请求，但每次实际编码使用排到执行时的快照，不承诺每个中间值都形成一份存档。
debounceMs 大于 0 时等待安静间隔；maxWaitMs 从成功水合后第一个待写变化起固定窗口上限，后续变化只延长安静间隔。maxWaitMs 为 0 是下一次 0ms 调度请求入队；debounceMs 为 0 则直接请求写入，不使用这一防抖窗口。maxWait 只限制请求入队时间，不限制排队等待或后端完成时间。
flush 取消当前防抖窗口，等待首次水合屏障；若水合失败抛原错，否则等待它已经观察到的实际写入，再请求当前快照写入并等待。并发严格 flush 与后台写共享真实 drain 结果，全部等待者能看到同一次原始失败；仅供后续调度恢复的 catch 链不会把这次失败改成成功。各 async 方法的公开 Promise 不被声明为相同 identity。
clear 同样取消窗口并等待水合，然后在写队列后删除此键，不重置业务内存。之后状态变化仍可重新写回。clearFamily 只处理匹配的存储键，不与所有活跃 keyed handle 合成原子事务。浏览器 beforeunload 也不保证等待 flush；应在明确的应用保存边界 await flush，并理解后端完成语义，而非只在卸载事件里 fire-and-forget。
dispose 同步、幂等：标记终态、请求 abort 所有在途适配器操作、取消防抖窗口、停止订阅。它不 dispose 借用的 Store、collection、AtomStore、Runtime 或 storage。释放后 flush / clear / retryHydrate 拒绝为带 ABORTED_BY_DISPOSE 的原生 AbortError，不复用旧 handle。
如果释放截断了一个已排定但未触发的防抖 timer，会当场捕获最后快照，并在既有写链之后发起一次最终写入。该写入不等待、不传已中止的 signal；最终编码 / I/O 或捕获失败保留在 writeError，即使 status 已 disposed。没有 pending timer 时不能笼统声称 dispose 总会额外保存一次。

取消复用 lifecycle 的原生 AbortController 工厂与默认 AbortError reason。后端若忽略 signal，已经发出的操作仍可能完成；等待者会在实际操作结算后观察终态，晚到原始失败保留在 AbortError cause。dispose 不是硬期限或强制终止后端的机制。需要确定保存结果时在资源仍可用时 await flush，再按应用顺序释放 handle 和业务资源。

blocks.text: 信封格式为 version（非负安全整数）与 state（非 null / undefined）。assertEnvelope(value, key) 拒绝非对象、数组、非法 version 或缺失 state，返回捕获的 version / state；两属性各读一次，属性访问或反射失败由 PersistEnvelopeError 包装并在 cause 保留。PersistEnvelopeError 继承 TypeError、携带 ENVELOPE_INVALID，key 用于标明存档身份。

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: A freshly edited field reverts when startup restoration finishes because a late archive replaces current memory wholesale.
Defaults overwrite a damaged archive before investigation because a settled read is mistaken for successful restoration.
A renamed field is not migrated while temporary fields get saved because schema conversion and write selection are mixed together.
A cart Map becomes an empty object after saving because ordinary JSON does not preserve collection entries.
Leaving one user screen stops another user from saving because an entire definition family shares one persistence lifetime.

Restore saved fields while retaining local startup edits. Instead of replacing memory with a late archive, the example keeps a local counter, restores an untouched theme, and saves both in the scenario.

Keep writes blocked until failed restoration is repaired. The example preserves the damaged archive, shares its original error, and saves only after a successful retry rather than overwriting it with defaults in the scenario.

Declare version conversion separately from saved-field selection. The example migrates an old theme and excludes temporary state instead of treating old schema as current or saving every session field in the scenario.

Round-trip collection entries with the default codec. Rather than silently turning a Map into an empty JSON object, the example restores book quantity in a new collection and removes a stale key in the scenario.

Release persistence independently for each key. Instead of coupling every user through a family-wide switch, the example stops one key while the other keeps saving and business memory remains usable in the scenario.

import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'
import { memoryStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-web/memory'
import { persist } from '@migaia/store-persist/light'

const storage = memoryStorageHost()
const settings = createStore({ theme: 'light' })
const handle = persist(settings, { key: 'settings', storage })
await handle.ready
settings.theme = 'dark'
await handle.flush()
console.log('saved:', (await storage.get('settings')) !== null)
handle.dispose()
await settings.$dispose()
storage.dispose()

blocks.text: This module connects state changes to storage: it reads archives, reconciles local edits during hydration, serializes writes, and manages debounce and disposal. It supplies neither a concrete backend nor encryption or a guarantee that page unload will finish saving. For one-off storage without state synchronization, use storage-contract and the desired backend directly. Choose storage and encryption appropriate to sensitive data; default JSON encoding is not encryption.

blocks.text: reactive, storage-contract, utils, and lifecycle are runtime dependencies. store-light, store-indexed, and store-keyed are optional peers: install the model you use. Install storage-web only when using its backend or codec. Directly install module your code imports rather than relying on transitive visibility. Obtain memoryStorageHost, localStorageHost, or indexedDbHost from storage-web's precise backend subentries; this module does not depend on concrete storage-web runtime values.

persistUnit(unit, options) is the shared engine. A unit supplies synchronous snapshot(), synchronous restore(state), and subscribe(onChange), which returns a disposer. Core options require key, runtime, and storage. The three facades supply their Store / collection / AtomStore Runtime automatically. The state unit, Runtime, and storage remain borrowed.

Core also captures configuration fields during construction and uses the admitted merge rather than rereading a caller getter during restore. Non-object options, failed reflection, or getter failure produce INVALID_OPTION TypeError; caught failures remain on cause. key, namespace, and id are checked as strings before concatenation, without silently converting objects or numbers or imposing an extra nonempty-string requirement. migrate, partialize, and merge must return synchronously. Promise / thenable results, or failed reads of then, produce INVALID_OPTION instead of storing a Promise as business state. Ordinary synchronous callback and backend exceptions retain their existing public error paths; not every failure is relabeled with one local code.

blocks.text: light $plain includes signal-backed fields, excluding computed values, WASM fields, and methods. $hydrate writes known signal fields and ignores unknown fields by default. Saving only selected fields with partialize therefore does not require restoring absent fields, and this facade has no separate merge option. Core's plain-object reconciliation still protects same-field edits made during hydration.

indexed snapshot keeps the collection's native shape, and replace follows that collection's atomic replacement admission. Invalid archives or failed version checks do not call restore. This is not a promise to roll back arbitrary external effects. Partial persistence of arrays / Maps / Sets needs a matching application merge, because default replacement can discard unsaved portions. Plain-object field reconciliation also does not replace deep business merging.

keyed requires namespace and storage and offers its declared shared options. Its storage key is namespace + ':' + id. It cannot inventory an entire family; each handle owns persistence for one definition and key. handle.value is captured before hydration and is not the live AtomStore value, which must be read from AtomStore. Extending the real engine handle preserves its live disposed getter.

clearFamily(storage, namespace) requires both arguments and returns `Promise<number>`. It enumerates storage.keys(), filters namespace + ':', and awaits removals in order. Its result counts matched enumerated keys rather than exclusive successful remove results. It neither clears AtomStore memory nor stops active handles, so later changes may recreate records. Logout that must also clear business values separately updates AtomStore and stops persistence as needed.

Construction captures startup state and subscribes before the asynchronous read. An absent archive hydrates successfully without replacing initial memory. A present archive is decoded and validated, migrated when its version differs and migrate exists, then merged and restored synchronously. Matching versions do not run migrate. A mismatch without migration produces ENVELOPE_INVALID rather than treating old schema as current.

Default merging handles plain objects with Object.prototype or null prototypes. It shallowly compares each current field against construction-time startup state using Object.is: locally changed fields win, untouched fields accept the archive, and unarchived current fields remain. It is not deep conflict resolution; mutation inside a retained nested reference is not recursively compared. Retry uses that same startup baseline. Arrays, Maps, Sets, and other non-plain shapes accept the persisted shape wholesale; a custom merge owns its application rules.

Changes during hydration mark dirty rather than writing over an unknown archive. Synchronous restore notifications join that window. Successful hydration schedules retained dirty work. Failure retains its error and dirty state; flush / clear throw the hydration error without writing until retryHydrate succeeds. A further retry call during recovery does not start a parallel read, but is not guaranteed to await that recovery or return the same Promise. Await the call that initiated retry to observe its result.

blocks.text: status, error, and hydrated are Runtime computed values. Hydration and write detail fields expose IReadonlyPersistValue.value. PersistState contains only idle, loading, writing, ready, success, error, and disposed, with no active member. IPersistCodecOutput was removed in favor of storage-contract ICodecOutput; runtime PersistCodecOutput retains text / structured / binary. Old type or member imports require migration without compatibility aliases.

A write reads the latest unit.snapshot, applies synchronous partialize, and passes { version, state } to the codec. Writes and deletions share one serial chain so a slow old write cannot finish after and overwrite a newer one. Changes coalesce into requests, and actual encoding reads state when that request executes; not every intermediate value becomes a separate archive.

Positive debounceMs waits for a quiet interval. maxWaitMs fixes an upper enqueue deadline from the first pending change after successful hydration; later changes extend only quiet time. maxWaitMs 0 requests enqueueing through the next zero-delay task. debounceMs 0 requests writing directly and uses no debounce window. maxWait bounds enqueueing, not queue wait or backend completion.

flush cancels the window and awaits the initial hydration barrier. A failed hydration rejects with its original error. Otherwise flush observes the actual write it had already seen, requests the current snapshot, and waits. Strict concurrent flushes and background callers share the actual drain result and can all observe the same original failure. The separate catch chain used for later scheduling recovery does not turn that result into success. Public async wrappers are not promised to return identical Promise objects.

clear also cancels the window, waits for hydration, then deletes the archive after earlier writes. It does not reset memory, and a later state change can save again. clearFamily does not combine every active keyed handle into a transaction. A browser beforeunload handler cannot guarantee that flush finishes. Await flush at an explicit application save boundary and interpret completion using the backend's contract.

sections.heading: Disposal, cancellation, and a final snapshot

blocks.text: dispose is synchronous and idempotent: it marks terminal state, requests abort on active adapter operations, cancels the debounce window, and unsubscribes. It does not dispose the borrowed Store, collection, AtomStore, Runtime, or storage. Subsequent flush / clear / retryHydrate reject with native AbortError carrying ABORTED_BY_DISPOSE; create another handle rather than reviving it.

If disposal cuts short a pending debounce timer, it captures the latest snapshot then schedules one final write behind the existing chain. This write is not awaited and receives no already-aborted signal. Capture, encoding, or I/O failure remains in writeError even while status is disposed. Without a pending timer, disposal does not unconditionally save another snapshot.

Cancellation reuses lifecycle's native AbortController and default AbortError reason. A backend ignoring signal may still complete already issued work; waiters observe termination after that actual operation settles, and a late original failure remains on the AbortError cause. dispose is not a hard I/O deadline or forced backend termination. For a confirmed save outcome, await flush while resources remain usable, then release persistence and business resources in application order.

An envelope contains a nonnegative safe-integer version and non-null / non-undefined state. assertEnvelope(value, key) rejects non-objects, arrays, invalid versions, and absent state, returning the captured version / state. Each property is read once; inaccessible properties or reflection failures become PersistEnvelopeError with the cause retained. This TypeError subclass carries ENVELOPE_INVALID, with key identifying the archive.

defaultJsonCodec is named migaia-collections-json-v1 with text output. It delegates to storage-contract collectionsJsonCodec and round-trips real Maps / Sets, including cross-realm collections, rather than ordinary JSON's silent empty-object encoding. JSON limits such as cycles and BigInt remain; it is not lossless encoding for arbitrary object graphs. Exact reserved versioned tuple shapes are not unrestricted application-array space.

Legacy reading recognizes only objects whose sole own key is `__migaia_persist_map__` or `__migaia_persist_set__` with an array value. Similar records containing extra fields retain all their data. An exact legacy marker selects the legacy reviver, preserving ordinary application arrays inside that archive rather than reinterpreting them as current tuples. Archives without exact legacy markers use current decoding. New write format and codec name remain unchanged.

defaultJsonCodec.encode wraps failure in ENCODE_FAILED TypeError with cause. decode rejects non-string or malformed JSON / markers with ENVELOPE_INVALID TypeError, retaining caught parse failures as cause. The default codec neither encrypts nor redacts. A custom codec owns the shapes it declares.

IPersistStorage is an internal minimal projection rather than a named module-entry export: capabilities, get, set, remove, and keys come from IKeyValueStore. It requires no backend, has, clearValues, clearAll, or dispose. Optional getBytes / setBytes / removeBytes come from IRecordStore, not IKeyValueStore itself. With a binary codec, clear() uses removeBytes to delete only that byte key, leaving other byte keys and the text/record channels alone; a binary-capable backend without removeBytes makes clear reject with a BACKEND_CAPABILITY TypeError instead of falling back to text removal. Backend and codec exceptions retain their own public identities and causes rather than all becoming local-source errors.

blocks.text: Save each example as its own .ts file and run it in an ESM project with Node 24. They use real memoryStorageHost rather than browser localStorage or IndexedDB; data survives only while that backend instance lives. Install the models you need; this command covers all six examples:

sections.heading: Keep edits made while an archive is loading

blocks.text: A settings archive contains an older counter, but the user changes it before startup restoration finishes.
Applying the saved object wholesale overwrites the new counter; skipping restoration also loses saved fields the user has not touched.
Attach persist before editing, then await ready. Its default plain-object merge compares each current field with the startup snapshot; flush writes the reconciled state.

memoryStorageHost() is the real in-memory backend, with settings as the archive key. defaultJsonCodec encodes a complete version 0 / state envelope. createStore starts at light / 0 and uses its default Runtime when omitted. persist requires key and storage; omitted version and debounceMs are 0 and partialize is identity. Plain objects use shallow startup reconciliation, and awaiting flush confirms this write has settled.
Output:

blocks.code:
restored: dark 1
saved: dark 1

blocks.text: The output is `restored: dark 1`, then `saved: dark 1`: the saved theme returns while the local counter wins.
The default version is 0 and debounceMs is 0. This is a shallow Object.is comparison for plain objects; arrays, Map and Set use whole-state replacement instead.

sections.heading: Repair a failed archive before reopening writes

blocks.text: A malformed archive makes startup fail, and the user keeps editing the live settings.
Writing defaults immediately would destroy the failed archive before it can be inspected or repaired; treating a settled Promise as successful restoration has the same risk.
Catch ready, inspect the failure, and repair the real storage record. Await retryHydrate before flushing; it reopens writes only after a successful read and restore.

storage.set first writes malformed JSON, and the example retains the first ready Promise and its error. Failed hydration does not save the local edit. retryHydrate takes no arguments and rereads the repaired archive; await that retry and flush. settled is not a success indicator, and retry does not replace ready. Key, codec, and debounce defaults match the first example.
Output:

blocks.code:
blocked: error true
untouched: true
recovered: ready 2 true
first attempt: true

blocks.text: The output is `blocked: error true`, `untouched: true`, `recovered: ready 2 true`, then `first attempt: true`.

Failed hydration blocks automatic writes and makes flush reject with the same failure. Retry keeps the original startup baseline and does not replace ready; settled alone only waits for the first attempt.

sections.heading: Migrate old settings and save only selected fields

blocks.text: A new release renames a saved field, while temporary session data must stay in memory.
Reading old state as if it already used the new schema loses the renamed value; serializing every field also writes temporary data into the archive.
Set version to 2, map the old state synchronously with migrate, and select saved fields with partialize. This example reads version 1 and explicitly retains only theme on writes.

Target version overrides 0 with 2 while the archive is version 1. migrate receives old state and fromVersion and must synchronously return new state. partialize selects theme instead of default identity. Unsaved temporary remains in the Store. Default reconciliation still uses startup state, and light restores through $hydrate. String conversion is this example's schema rule, not a universal migration policy.
Output:

blocks.code:
migrated: 1 dark session-only
archive: 2 contrast false

blocks.text: The output is `migrated: 1 dark session-only`, then `archive: 2 contrast false`: the renamed field is restored and the temporary field is absent from storage.

Version defaults to 0; a mismatch without migrate fails hydration. partialize defaults to identity, and both callbacks must return synchronously. migrate converts the state to restore; this example awaits flush to confirm the new archive is written.

sections.heading: Restore a Map without losing its entries

blocks.text: A cart stored as an observable Map must survive a new collection instance.
Plain JSON serialization turns a Map into an empty object; patching entries into an existing collection can also leave obsolete keys behind.
Pass the real ObservableMap to persistCollection and flush before releasing it. The default codec preserves Map entries, and restoration calls replace on the new collection.

The first ObservableMap is empty; its restore target starts with only stale: 99. Both omit explicit Runtime configuration. persistCollection takes the collection and key / storage without another application subscription. The default codec supports Map, with version and debounceMs 0. Default Map restoration replaces the whole state, removing stale; partial persistence needs a matching explicit merge.

blocks.code:
import { ObservableMap } from '@migaia/store-indexed'
import { memoryStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-web/memory'
import { defaultJsonCodec } from '@migaia/store-persist'
import { persistCollection } from '@migaia/store-persist/indexed'

const storage = memoryStorageHost()
const cart = new ObservableMap<string, number>()
const first = persistCollection(cart, { key: 'cart', storage })
await first.ready
cart.set('book', 2)
await first.flush()
first.dispose()
cart.dispose()
const restored = new ObservableMap<string, number>([['stale', 99]])
const second = persistCollection(restored, { key: 'cart', storage })
await second.ready
console.log('restored:', restored.get('book'), restored.has('stale'))
const saved = (await defaultJsonCodec.decode(await storage.get('cart'))) as { state: unknown }
console.log('map:', saved.state instanceof Map)
second.dispose()
restored.dispose()
storage.dispose()

blocks.text: Output:

blocks.code:
restored: 2 false
map: true

blocks.text: The output is `restored: 2 false`, then `map: true`: book returns, stale disappears, and the decoded archive still contains a Map.
The default codec is defaultJsonCodec, version is 0, and debounceMs is 0. Map restoration replaces the whole state; use an explicit merge when a selected subset needs shape-specific reconciliation.

sections.heading: Stop saving one key while another keeps working

blocks.text: Two user profiles share a definition family, but leaving one screen should stop saving only that profile.
A family-wide listener couples unrelated keys, and reading handle.value as a live value keeps displaying the snapshot captured before restoration.
Create one persistKeyed handle per definition and explicit id. Await ready, read current values through AtomStore, and dispose only the handle whose persistence is no longer needed.

createAtomStore uses the explicitly created Runtime. familyDef initializes each key with an empty name. persistKeyed explicitly receives def, string id, namespace, and storage, forming users:u1 / users:u2 rather than inferring ids from definitions. first.value is the initial snapshot; atoms.peek reads current values. Handles are independent and do not dispose AtomStore.
Output:

blocks.code:
initial: true Ada
archives: Grace Barbara
memory: Changed

blocks.text: The output is `initial: true Ada`, `archives: Grace Barbara`, then `memory: Changed`: stopping u1 leaves its last archive intact while u2 still saves.

Each key uses namespace:id; id is not inferred from the definition. value is the attachment-time snapshot. Disposing persistence does not dispose AtomStore or reset business values; version and debounceMs default to 0.

sections.heading: Clear saved records without resetting live values

blocks.text: A sign-out flow removes one namespace from storage, yet a mounted screen still holds its current value.
Deleting records does not reset live state or remove its subscriptions. Assuming it does can make the next edit silently recreate a supposedly cleared archive.

Use clearFamily to remove matching records, then separately decide whether to reset business values or dispose their persistence handles. This example keeps a handle active to show the next write explicitly.

clearFamily requires storage and namespace. users matches users: but not other:u1. The result counts matching keys without deleting live definitions or subscriptions. The active handle remains attached, so atoms.set followed by flush recreates the archive. Separately dispose that handle when persistence must stop.

blocks.code:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { createAtomStore, familyDef } from '@migaia/store-keyed'
import { memoryStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-web/memory'
import { persistKeyed, clearFamily } from '@migaia/store-persist/keyed'

const storage = memoryStorageHost()
await storage.set('other:u1', 'keep')
const atoms = createAtomStore(createRuntime())
const counter = familyDef(() => 0)
const def = counter('u1')
const handle = persistKeyed(atoms, def, 'u1', { namespace: 'users', storage })
await handle.ready
atoms.set(def, 7)
await handle.flush()
console.log('matched:', await clearFamily(storage, 'users'))
console.log(
  'after clear:',
  await storage.get('users:u1'),
  atoms.peek(def),
  await storage.get('other:u1')
)
atoms.set(def, 8)
await handle.flush()
console.log('recreated:', (await storage.get('users:u1')) !== null)
handle.dispose()
atoms.dispose()
storage.dispose()

blocks.text: Output:

blocks.code:
matched: 1
after clear: null 7 keep
recreated: true

blocks.text: The output is `matched: 1`, `after clear: null 7 keep`, then `recreated: true`: only users:u1 is removed, memory remains 7, and a later edit saves again.

The result counts keys matching namespace plus a colon at enumeration time, not successful remove booleans. Removal is sequential, not transactional; earlier removals remain if a later backend call fails.

This module connects state changes to storage: it reads archives, reconciles local edits during hydration, serializes writes, and manages debounce and disposal. It supplies neither a concrete backend nor encryption or a guarantee that page unload will finish saving. For one-off storage without state synchronization, use storage-contract and the desired backend directly. Choose storage and encryption appropriate to sensitive data; default JSON encoding is not encryption.

blocks.text: reactive, storage-contract, utils, and lifecycle are runtime dependencies. store-light, store-indexed, and store-keyed are optional peers: install the model you use. Install storage-web only when using its backend or codec. Directly install module your code imports rather than relying on transitive visibility. persistUnit(unit, options) is the shared engine. A unit supplies synchronous snapshot(), synchronous restore(state), and subscribe(onChange), which returns a disposer. Core options require key, runtime, and storage. The three facades supply their Store / collection / AtomStore Runtime automatically. The state unit, Runtime, and storage remain borrowed.

Core also captures configuration fields during construction and uses the admitted merge rather than rereading a caller getter during restore. blocks.text: light $plain includes signal-backed fields, excluding computed values, WASM fields, and methods. $hydrate writes known signal fields and ignores unknown fields by default. Saving only selected fields with partialize therefore does not require restoring absent fields, and this facade has no separate merge option. Core's plain-object reconciliation still protects same-field edits made during hydration.

indexed snapshot keeps the collection's native shape, and replace follows that collection's atomic replacement admission. Invalid archives or failed version checks do not call restore. This is not a promise to roll back arbitrary external effects. Partial persistence of arrays / Maps / Sets needs a matching application merge, because default replacement can discard unsaved portions. Plain-object field reconciliation also does not replace deep business merging.

keyed requires namespace and storage and offers its declared shared options. Its storage key is namespace + ':' + id. It cannot inventory an entire family; each handle owns persistence for one definition and key. handle.value is captured before hydration and is not the live AtomStore value, which must be read from AtomStore. Extending the real engine handle preserves its live disposed getter.

clearFamily(storage, namespace) requires both arguments and returns `Promise<number>`. It enumerates storage.keys(), filters namespace + ':', and awaits removals in order. Its result counts matched enumerated keys rather than exclusive successful remove results. It neither clears AtomStore memory nor stops active handles, so later changes may recreate records. Logout that must also clear business values separately updates AtomStore and stops persistence as needed.

Construction captures startup state and subscribes before the asynchronous read. An absent archive hydrates successfully without replacing initial memory. A present archive is decoded and validated, migrated when its version differs and migrate exists, then merged and restored synchronously. Matching versions do not run migrate. A mismatch without migration produces ENVELOPE_INVALID rather than treating old schema as current.

Default merging handles plain objects with Object.prototype or null prototypes. It shallowly compares each current field against construction-time startup state using Object.is: locally changed fields win, untouched fields accept the archive, and unarchived current fields remain. It is not deep conflict resolution; mutation inside a retained nested reference is not recursively compared. Retry uses that same startup baseline. Arrays, Maps, Sets, and other non-plain shapes accept the persisted shape wholesale; a custom merge owns its application rules.

Changes during hydration mark dirty rather than writing over an unknown archive. Synchronous restore notifications join that window. Successful hydration schedules retained dirty work. Failure retains its error and dirty state; flush / clear throw the hydration error without writing until retryHydrate succeeds. A further retry call during recovery does not start a parallel read, but is not guaranteed to await that recovery or return the same Promise. Await the call that initiated retry to observe its result.

PersistState contains only idle, loading, writing, ready, success, error, and disposed, with no active member. IPersistCodecOutput was removed in favor of storage-contract ICodecOutput; runtime PersistCodecOutput retains text / structured / binary. Old type or member imports require migration without compatibility aliases.

A write reads the latest unit.snapshot, applies synchronous partialize, and passes { version, state } to the codec. Writes and deletions share one serial chain so a slow old write cannot finish after and overwrite a newer one. Changes coalesce into requests, and actual encoding reads state when that request executes; not every intermediate value becomes a separate archive.

Positive debounceMs waits for a quiet interval. maxWaitMs fixes an upper enqueue deadline from the first pending change after successful hydration; later changes extend only quiet time. maxWaitMs 0 requests enqueueing through the next zero-delay task. debounceMs 0 requests writing directly and uses no debounce window. maxWait bounds enqueueing, not queue wait or backend completion.

flush cancels the window and awaits the initial hydration barrier. A failed hydration rejects with its original error. Otherwise flush observes the actual write it had already seen, requests the current snapshot, and waits. Strict concurrent flushes and background callers share the actual drain result and can all observe the same original failure. The separate catch chain used for later scheduling recovery does not turn that result into success. Public async wrappers are not promised to return identical Promise objects.

clear also cancels the window, waits for hydration, then deletes the archive after earlier writes. It does not reset memory, and a later state change can save again. clearFamily does not combine every active keyed handle into a transaction. A browser beforeunload handler cannot guarantee that flush finishes. Await flush at an explicit application save boundary and interpret completion using the backend's contract.

sections.heading: Disposal, cancellation, and a final snapshot

blocks.text: dispose is synchronous and idempotent: it marks terminal state, requests abort on active adapter operations, cancels the debounce window, and unsubscribes. It does not dispose the borrowed Store, collection, AtomStore, Runtime, or storage. Subsequent flush / clear / retryHydrate reject with native AbortError carrying ABORTED_BY_DISPOSE; create another handle rather than reviving it.

If disposal cuts short a pending debounce timer, it captures the latest snapshot then schedules one final write behind the existing chain. This write is not awaited and receives no already-aborted signal. Capture, encoding, or I/O failure remains in writeError even while status is disposed. Without a pending timer, disposal does not unconditionally save another snapshot.

Cancellation reuses lifecycle's native AbortController and default AbortError reason. A backend ignoring signal may still complete already issued work; waiters observe termination after that actual operation settles, and a late original failure remains on the AbortError cause. dispose is not a hard I/O deadline or forced backend termination. For a confirmed save outcome, await flush while resources remain usable, then release persistence and business resources in application order.

An envelope contains a nonnegative safe-integer version and non-null / non-undefined state. assertEnvelope(value, key) rejects non-objects, arrays, invalid versions, and absent state, returning the captured version / state. Each property is read once; inaccessible properties or reflection failures become PersistEnvelopeError with the cause retained. This TypeError subclass carries ENVELOPE_INVALID, with key identifying the archive.

defaultJsonCodec is named migaia-collections-json-v1 with text output. It delegates to storage-contract collectionsJsonCodec and round-trips real Maps / Sets, including cross-realm collections, rather than ordinary JSON's silent empty-object encoding. JSON limits such as cycles and BigInt remain; it is not lossless encoding for arbitrary object graphs. Exact reserved versioned tuple shapes are not unrestricted application-array space.

Legacy reading recognizes only objects whose sole own key is `__migaia_persist_map__` or `__migaia_persist_set__` with an array value. Similar records containing extra fields retain all their data. An exact legacy marker selects the legacy reviver, preserving ordinary application arrays inside that archive rather than reinterpreting them as current tuples. Archives without exact legacy markers use current decoding. New write format and codec name remain unchanged.

defaultJsonCodec.encode wraps failure in ENCODE_FAILED TypeError with cause. decode rejects non-string or malformed JSON / markers with ENVELOPE_INVALID TypeError, retaining caught parse failures as cause. The default codec neither encrypts nor redacts. A custom codec owns the shapes it declares.

IPersistStorage is an internal minimal projection rather than a named module-entry export: capabilities, get, set, remove, and keys come from IKeyValueStore. It requires no backend, has, clearValues, clearAll, or dispose. Optional getBytes / setBytes / removeBytes come from IRecordStore, not IKeyValueStore itself. With a binary codec, clear() uses removeBytes to delete only that byte key, leaving other byte keys and the text/record channels alone; a binary-capable backend without removeBytes makes clear reject with a BACKEND_CAPABILITY TypeError instead of falling back to text removal. Backend and codec exceptions retain their own public identities and causes rather than all becoming local-source errors.

Binary with true capability uses getBytes then codec.decode; missing byte methods produce BACKEND_CAPABILITY, while false binary capability produces CODEC_OUTPUT_MISMATCH. Non-binary reads use get + decode. Missing values return undefined.

status: IReactiveComputed selecting disposed first, then loading, then hydration/write error, otherwise ready. A write can be active while overall status remains ready.
error: Computed current hydration or write failure; simultaneous failures form AggregateError preserving both originals.
hydrated: Computed true only after a successful hydration attempt; disposal does not convert an incomplete hydration into success.
hydrationStatus: Readonly .value projection reporting loading, success or error for the latest hydration attempt.
hydrationError: Readonly .value containing the latest hydration failure; cleared when another hydration attempt starts.
writeStatus: Readonly .value reporting idle, writing, error or disposed independently of hydration status.
writeError: Readonly .value retaining the latest failed write or removal; successful writes clear it and a final disposal write may update it later.
ready: Original first-hydration-attempt Promise: resolves only on success and rejects on failure or disposal before completion with AbortError/ABORTED_BY_DISPOSE. Retries do not replace this Promise.

blocks.text: facade 先捕获 options 自身属性；getter 使用原 options 作为 receiver 读取一次。核心也在创建时捕获配置字段，恢复使用已捕获并验证的 merge，不重新读取调用方的 getter。非对象、反射或 getter 失败以 INVALID_OPTION TypeError 报告，捕获的原因为 cause。key、namespace、id 在拼接前检查字符串，不把对象或数字悄悄转成键，也不额外要求非空字符串。容量时间、version 与回调形状在创建持久化状态前按实际配置校验。
migrate、partialize、merge 都是同步回调，不能返回 Promise / thenable；异步结果或读取 then 失败以 INVALID_OPTION 拒绝，避免 Promise 被当作业务状态写入。普通同步业务回调或后端异常保留原来的公共错误路径；不要把所有失败都改判为某一个本包码。
STORE_PERSIST_SOURCE 为 @migaia/store-persist；稳定码由 StorePersistErrorCode 维护：

blocks.text: 配置 version 非负安全整数等非法项同步 TypeError；信封问题由 PersistEnvelopeError 报告。水合失败后 flush / clear 继续抛 hydrationError，成功 retry 才解锁；写入失败查 writeError，并检查 codec 与后端是否匹配。已释放 handle 不能重用，业务内存和存档删除需分别管理。

公开错误工厂 createStorePersistError / createStorePersistTypeError 接收必填 code、message 和可选 options.cause；createStorePersistAbortError 接收 code、message、可选 cause，返回原生 DOMException，保持 name 为 AbortError；createStorePersistAggregateError 接收 code、errors、message，errors 保留原失败。code 类型为 IStorePersistErrorCode，工厂附加身份但不覆盖 stack。底层工具不需要在普通 Store 使用中自行重复实现。
